title: Design and export scoped order profit evidence pages to Excel
description: A user opens a field designer from the existing order-profit report and selects approved order evidence columns for preview/Excel. Introduce narrow DTO/rules/controller files with a finite field whitelist derived from ERP-220 row DTOs (identity/date/customer/original currency/sales and explicit cost/profit unknown evidence; any current-price estimate remains separately labeled). Preserve selected field order; date validation and source caps must reuse the authorized bounded service, with Page>=1 and PageSize 1..200, stable page slicing and server Total/PageOnly metadata. Catalog/preview/Excel each recheck identity/order-profit menu/fresh ERP scope; no cached permission or client-supplied totals. Designer supports dates, fields, page controls, empty/denied/invalid/network states and safe text, showing page-only coverage, original currency and unknown basis even when corresponding columns are deselected. Excel reruns the same preview, exports selected page fields in order as numeric/date/formula-safe text cells, and records date/page/source limits and missing cost basis; null amount is unknown rather than numeric zero, no cross-currency sums. Do not add production DB configuration or new menus. Development only: reuse existing ERP order-profit menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. No client-supplied identity/scope/rows/amount totals, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Unavailable external environment acceptance must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Finite catalog and validated fields/dates/Page/PageSize drive a freshly authorized bounded service preview; stable selected-page rows retain original currency and unknown-cost evidence with server-derived Total/PageOnly metadata.

Existing order-profit entry opens a field/date/page designer preserving selection order and effective server context, with safe text and clear unknown/empty/denied/error states; no cross-currency totals or profit claims.

Excel independently rechecks authorization/validation and exports only selected page fields with typed values, formula-safe labels, explicit null/unknown values and date/page/currency/basis context; API/workbook/UI regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
